BiblicalUsage: Naam is a son of Caleb named once in the genealogies, and that single mention is all Scripture gives him. In 1 Chronicles 4:15 he stands among the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh, listed with Iru and Elah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name written once in the record is still written by God, and that is enough. Naam did not need a story to be counted among the people of God.
